scope: Final configured asset set, derived locally from current source and saved QA. Not a candidate shortlist. No Studio calls made for this document.

validation.claimLimit: Loaded confirms access/decode in the saved test, not future availability, rights clearance, perceived loudness, fatigue or listening approval.

sourcePolicy.summary: Roblox describes Creator Store audio for use within Roblox experiences. Partner/distributor metadata was recorded without assuming availability alone proves every right. No anime/game IP rip was selected; no license for off-platform extraction or redistribution is claimed.

mix.sfxVolumeFormula: layer.volume * trim.gain * random(0.96,1.04) * options.volume * (remote ? 0.36 : 1) * (auto ? 0.82 : 1), then group chain, effects and distance attenuation
mix.durationFormula: min(requested layer duration, max(0.03, (TimeLength - offset) / clamped PlaybackSpeed))
mix.notes: Linear volume products are configuration factors, not LUFS, dBFS or a perceptual normalization guarantee. Music duck and compressor/EQ affect the resulting signal.

review.finding: All 31 configured IDs match final saved QA and report loaded=true. All configured offsets are inside runtime file lengths.
New tone is 9125531715; previous tonal glass 9114619221 remains only in glass impact family. Older shortlist recommendations are not all installed.

Tone length 0.657833333 s minus 0.200 s trim leaves 0.457833333 s at 1x. Long rarity windows are source-capped: Secret final note at 2.5x plays at most about 0.183133333 s, despite requested 0.75 s. Bounds-safe; perceived sustain still requires listening approval.

Saved waveform JSON contains prior glass/stone/coin/swing onset measurements, but no new tone 9125531715 entry. Its offset/gain are confirmed configuration, not independently remeasured for this manifest.
Music metadata confirms four APMOfficial and three DistrokidOfficial creators; three distributor tracks have empty descriptions and no separately captured per-track license terms.
Regional energy/wind loops use endpoint volume ramps; this is not an equal-power seam crossfade and cannot establish an inaudible seam without listening.
Creator Store source durations differ from runtime lengths; both are preserved and TimeLength controls playback bounds.
